questions.question: In the prophet Micah's message, when the LORD comes down to tread on the earth's high places, what do the mountains do?
The prophet Micah said the LORD was coming forth in judgment against Samaria and Jerusalem. What was this because of?
Through the prophet Micah, the LORD said He would make Samaria a heap of rubble. What did He say the spot would become?

answers.text: A planting area for a vineyard
A pasture for flocks of sheep
A camp for an army of soldiers
